comment: Communities and districts along the Airport Run route (Norman Manley → Ocho Rios). Each entry triggers an in-world community sign + HUD callout (recognition layer 2). Entries with needs_owner_review require the owner's lived knowledge to confirm placement — the owner's experience is authoritative over map data.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: Narrow sand-spit linking the airport to Kingston — coconut trees, sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway into Kingston at the roundabout off the Palisadoes

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Community along Windward Road with the old Rockfort mineral bath

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Kingston east community along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital of Jamaica — the route threads through the city centre

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's commercial heart — clock tower, busy market, route-taxi hub

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major junction south of Half Way Tree where several roads converge

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: St. Catherine's capital — Jamaica's historic former capital, founded 1534

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Community on the road north toward Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Famous low bridge over the Rio Cobre — floods when the river rises

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town at the north end of the gorge — junction on the Rio Cobre plain

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town made famous by the folk song 'Linstead Market' — bustling on Saturdays

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hill country between Linstead and Moneague — goat country

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous hilltop cookshop row — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. Mandatory stop.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Village at the St. Ann crossroads before the long descent to Ocho Rios

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Kilometre-long gorge canopied by bamboo — one of Jamaica's most iconic drives

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Jamaica's north-coast tourist hub — Dunn's River Falls finish
